hypothesis: L013 showed that a cluster2 extra_trees/raw expert slightly improved reported-zero MAE relative to G01 but worsened positive-Tc and pooled MAE, while cluster2 contains no high-Tc rows. Replacing only that expert with hist_gradient_boosting/raw may smooth localized errors enough to reverse the zero-versus-positive tradeoff without changing cluster0, cluster1, or high-Tc predictions.
falsification: The hypothesis is falsified as an eligible improvement unless pooled weighted training OOF MAE is below 7.742598770753422 K, a gain of at least 0.01 K over A05, and positive-Tc MAE is at most the fixed G01 guard of 8.832165507919859 K. Any isolated subgroup or route improvement without both conditions is only a development tradeoff.
reason: The continuation minimum is pending at 17 of 22 successful unique cycles, so another untried valid configuration is required. This is the direct cluster2 estimator-only analogue of L016 and L017 and isolates estimator choice relative to L013 while preserving the G01 extra_trees/raw fallback elsewhere.
